name: NACA 0012 · Re 6 million, alpha 10°
description: NACA 0012 at Re=6 million with a smaller far-field box and SST RANS wall functions.

expectations.notes: Starter domain (-10,-10) to (15,10)c. Geometry is a 160-segment sharp-trailing-edge approximation. The case is a solver setup, not an accuracy certification.

sources.title: NASA TMR: 2D NACA 0012 Airfoil Validation
sources.notes: Scaled sharp trailing edge and Re=6e6; finite polygon and compact farfield differ from the reference grids.

sources.title: Effects of Independent Variation of Mach and Reynolds Numbers on the Low-Speed Aerodynamic Characteristics of the NACA 0012 Airfoil Section
sources.notes: Use tripped Re=6 million data for fully turbulent force comparisons.

dimensionless.notes: Set by the case viscosity and freestream speed.

scales.definition: Angle of attack; geometry remains chord-aligned

comparisons.procedure: Project force normal to freestream: lift=(-sin(alpha),cos(alpha),0) dot F; use 0.5 rho U² c per unit depth. Compare tripped Re=6e6 data at alpha=10°.
Project force along freestream, divide by 0.5 rho U² c. Refine wall-normal spacing, polygon and farfield separately before interpreting drag error.
Cp=(p/rho-p_infinity/rho)/(0.5 U²). Export airfoil wall pressure; compare upper/lower branches versus x/c at alpha=10°.

verification.notes: Case recipe; no numerical validation claimed.
